statement: The client, with a Cautious risk profile (risk class 2), has an investment horizon of 8 years, an objective of income generation, and a good capacity to bear losses. It consists of Carmignac Sécurité AW EUR Acc (SRI 2) and iShares € Govt Bond 1-3yr UCITS ETF EUR Dist (SRI 2), resulting in a weighted average SRI of 2, which aligns with the client's risk class.
